description: [Approved mode — write] This tool creates a record in Pushizo. It only creates a DRAFT and never sends or schedules a message; the API key needs the `mcp:write` scope. Get explicit approval from the user before calling it. Creates a survey (question types: nps, csat, single_choice, multiple_choice, text) as `draft`; it collects no responses until a person activates it. Example questions: [{"id":"nps","type":"nps","text":{"en":"How likely are you to recommend us?"},"required":true},{"id":"why","type":"text","text":{"en":"Why?"}}].

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

settings.description: Thank-you message and other settings (get_survey `settings` format).

name: create_survey_draft
title: Create survey draft
